corePassives.description:
After gaining 2 Instinct Points, Inner Hollow enters Instinct Burst, increasing his ATK by 20%. While in Shikai, the 4th hit of his basic attack, the 2nd hit of his technique, and counterattack each consume 1 Instinct Point to release Getsuga Tensho. ~~King & His Horse~~ 
 When Inner Hollow and Ichigo Kurosaki - Bankai are in the same team, Ichigo's ATK increases by 30% during his Hollowfied Ultimate state.
corePassives.name: Instinct Burst

corePassives.description: Increases Inner Hollow's Crit DMG during battle by 60%.

skills.description:
Inner Hollow repeatedly swings his Zanpakuto to slash enemies in front, dealing 4 hits in total equal to 600% of ATK and building up his Spiritual Pressure. 
 While Instinct Burst is active, the 4th hit of his basic attack also consumes 1 Instinct Point to release an extra Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal 750% of ATK. ~~Rampage of Madness~~ Bankai State 
 Inner Hollow swings Tensa Zangetsu in an almost frenzied manner, dealing 6 hits in total equal to 895% of ATK. Each hit automatically consumes Spiritual Pressure to release a Getsuga Tensho, dealing a total damage equal to 3000% of ATK. ~~Cleaving Throw~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, tap and hold basic attack 
 Inner Hollow grabs the bandages wrapped around Zangetsu and spins rapidly, then hurls it at distant enemies, dealing damage equal to 987.5% of ATK. When drawing the blade, he also releases a Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 500% of ATK and gaining 1 Instinct Point. 
 While Inner Hollow's Battlefield Skill is active, the first time a teammate is switched in within 8 seconds after landing this attack, that teammate will automatically release their counterattack. The damage and Spiritual Pressure Reduction Rate of this counterattack are reduced by 50%.
skills.name: Zangetsu's True Power

skills.description:
Inner Hollow slashes horizontally, then leaps up and slams his Zanpakuto into the ground, dealing 2 hits in total equal to 1430% of ATK and building up his Spiritual Pressure. 
 While Instinct Burst is active, the 2nd hit of his downward smash also consumes 1 Instinct Point to release three extra rounds of Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 750% of ATK.
skills.name: Crushing Drop

skills.description:
Inner Hollow releases the power of his Zanpakuto and enters Bankai, then swings out of Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 1470% of ATK, increasing his Spiritual Pressure to maximum, and entering Instinct Burst. During Bankai, his basic attacks are greatly enhanced and can continue to release combo attacks at the backline, but Techniques and Special Attacks cannot be used. When Inner  Hollow's Battlefield Skill is active, he can release combo attacks at the backline. ~~Crimson Getsuga~~ During Bankai, release it again at Max Ultimate Energy 
 Inner Hollow gathers power into Tensa Zangetsu, then swings forcefully at the enemy to unleash a massive Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 5882.5% of ATK. Bankai ends after release.
skills.name: Bankai - Tensa Zangetsu

skills.description:
Inner Hollow guards against an enemy attack, then counters with his Zanpakuto, dealing damage equal to 1440% of ATK. 
 While Instinct Burst is active, his counterattack also consumes 1 Instinct Point to release an extra Getsuga Tensho, dealing damage equal to 750% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While the Inner Hollow's Battlefield Skill is active, all teammates' Slash DMG increases by 40%.~~ 
 
 Inner Hollow's Battlefield Skill uses two energy types: Battlefield Skill Energy and Instinct Point, which release two different Battlefield Skills: Crushing Rondo and Finishing Strike. Teammates' basic attacks, special attacks, and techniques increase Battlefield Skill Energy on hit. Cooldown: 0.9 seconds. Releasing Crushing Rondo or Inner Hollow's Special Attacks grant Instinct Points. In Instinct Burst, Battlefield Skill Energy can no longer be gained. ~~Crushing Rondo~~ Requires max Battlefield Skill Energy 
 Switches Inner Hollow onto the field. He spins his Zanpakuto in a wide area, pulling nearby enemies toward him, dealing damage equal to 2685% of ATK and gaining 1 Instinct Point. ~~Finishing Strike~~ Obtain and consume all Instinct Points 
 Inner Hollow leaps high into the air and swings his Zanpakuto down to strike enemies, dealing damage equal to 4010% of ATK and ending Instinct Burst after use.
skills.name: I Will Become the King

skills.description: Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Inner Hollow gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. During Bankai, Inner Hollow will trigger Sonido automatically to avoid damage right before taking a hit from the enemy.
skills.name: Sonido
